LESSON: THINGS IN MY SCHOOL

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: OUR SCHOOL Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Exper
Topic 5.2: Things in my school
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Things in my school, part of OUR SCHOOL Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Exper in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we have schools? 2. Which things are found in our school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Things in my school together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Patriotism: citizenship as learner colours the flag.

● Responsibility: accountability as learner uses things found in school properly.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Financial literacy – learners learn to use economic resources properly as they use things found in school.

Developmental perspective – learners enhance unity and cooperation as they sing songs about things found in school in groups,

Link to other learning area:

Learners learn to colour the school flag.
